appraisal_events.evidence: « La jalousie, qui a un bandeau sur les yeux, n'est pas seulement impuissante à rien découvrir dans les ténèbres qui l'enveloppent, elle est encore un de ces supplices où la tâche est à recommencer sans cesse, comme celle des Danaïdes, comme celle d'Ixion » ; « toujours en retard, elle se précipite comme un taureau furieux là où ne se trouve pas l'être fier et brillant qui l'irrite » ; « notre vie pareille à un songe » ; his « cruelles attaques » on Albertine's contradictions are « cruelles surtout pour moi ».
appraisal_events.explanation: The dominant body of the passage is the narrator's own analysis of his jealousy as blind, retrospective, impotent and puerile, a self-renewing torture set off by a single name in a newspaper. The narration plainly endorses this self-diminishment rather than merely reporting it.

appraisal_events.evidence: Françoise is sent with a fabricated pretext ; « Albertine ne verrait ni Léa ni ses amies » ; « en quittant la matinée et en rentrant sur un signe de moi, qu'elle m'appartenait plus que je ne me le figurais » ; her note « Toute à vous, ton Albertine » ; but also « Il m'était si doux d'avoir l'air d'être aimé ! » and the danger « perdit aussitôt à mes yeux de son importance ».
appraisal_events.explanation: The stratagem succeeds: Albertine leaves the Trocadéro at a signal, cut off from Léa's circle and framed as belonging to the narrator, which locally reduces her autonomy even as her affectionate note wins his gratitude. The narration ironizes the victory, since it rests on a lie and yields only the appearance of being loved.

status_effects.explanation: He comes off worse locally because the passage exposes his jealousy as blind, futile and childish, driven by evidence his memory cannot even supply.

He nonetheless ends the passage with leverage restored: the feared meeting is prevented, Albertine returns on his signal, and he receives an affectionate note; the gain is modest because the text presents it as relief and appearance rather than transformation.
She is removed from the Trocadéro matinée and from any contact with Léa and the two young women, her afternoon cancelled by a manoeuvre she does not know about.

ambiguities: The closing turn (danger conjured, Albertine returning at a signal, her affectionate letter) could be read as an endorsed affective renewal, but the passage itself deflates it — the danger instantly loses importance, the narrator notes it was sweet only « d'avoir l'air d'être aimé », and the return was obtained by a fabricated pretext — so it is treated as qualified relief and regained control rather than realized intimacy.

Whether the passage's damaging picture of Albertine (the four-stage lies, the anacoluthes, « l'aveu... de son penchant ») is narrator-endorsed truth or a construction of the jealousy the same passage calls blind and puerile is genuinely undecided; for that reason no general_appraisal diminishment is recorded for her.
